scientific_limitations: The classification assumes the base semiring is the ordinary nonnegative integers and the overflow component is a nonempty finite chain.
The counting formula enumerates distinct congruence kernels of a given finite index, not quotient isomorphism classes.
The historical literature comparison is non-exhaustive; earlier one-overflow descriptions may exist.
